# Awesome Free Games 1000

A collection of 997 source game pages across 6 directory categories. "1000" is the project name and goal, not a certification of 1000 unique completed games.

- [Game lobby](https://stephen-taipei.github.io/awesome-free-games-1000/): search, category filters and local favorites
- [Complete catalogue](https://stephen-taipei.github.io/awesome-free-games-1000/catalog.html): crawlable, no-JavaScript directory
- [Catalogue data](https://stephen-taipei.github.io/awesome-free-games-1000/catalog.json): stable category/slug IDs and literal translated titles
- [Sitemap](https://stephen-taipei.github.io/awesome-free-games-1000/sitemap.xml)

Games run in the browser. Translation, touch support, WebGPU support and gameplay completeness vary per game. Some horror titles contain frightening content. No Firebase integration is configured. Analytics is optional and inactive without an explicit measurement ID.
